# 2026 Wigan Warriors Women season__disambig_1

The 2026 season is the Wigan Warriors Women's 9th consecutive season in the top flight of English women's rugby league. The club are competing in the 2026 Betfred Women's Super League and the 2026 Women's Challenge Cup.
The team is captained by Georgia Wilson, after Vicky Molyneux's retirement, with head coach Denis Betts taking charge of the team for his third season.
The 2026 season comes off the back of Wigan's treble-winning 2025 season, where the team won the 2025 Challenge Cup, the League Leaders' Shield, and the 2025 Super League Grand Final.
Super League
On the 26 January 2026, it was announced that the Betfred Women's Super League format would be changed for the upcoming season. Each team would face each other once, home or away, in a single round of fixtures, with the top and bottom four teams then facing each other home and away in an extended Play-Off series. The team in first at the end of these fixtures would be crowned League Leaders, and earn a place in the Grand Final, whilst the second and third place teams would face off for the final spot in the match.
Wigan's fixtures were announced on 26 January 2026, with their first match against Leeds Rhinos on Saturday 16 May, at Edge Hall Road Community Stadium.
Results
Challenge Cup
The draw for the 2026 Women's Challenge Cup meant that three teams would compete in a single round robin, with matches played over three consecutive weekends in April 2026, with the group winner and runners-up advancing to the knockout rounds.
Wigan were drawn in Group C, alongside Featherstone Rovers and Cardiff Demons, with the matches set to take place on 4 April and 11 April.
